diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker did not pass any of the content checks (C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6). However, the settlement in each case did not explicitly reference the necessary decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, PF4) that the checks are supposed to depend on. Instead, the decisions were based on the revealed facts (S1, S2, S3, S4), which do not contain the required information. This suggests that the model is defaulting to a conservative or neutral decision without the need for additional information.
